newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OUB switches insurance unit fund manager.
newsitem.headline: OUB switches insurance unit fund manager.

text.p: Overseas Union Bank Ltd (OUB) said on Wednesday it was switching its fund manager and investment adviser at its insurance unit, Overseas Union Insurance Ltd (OUI).

OUB said in a statement it had appointed its OUB Asset Management Ltd (OUBAM) unit to replace another OUB unit, Overseas Union Bank Trustees Ltd (OUBT), as manager for OUI's Singapore $58.0 million-strong Singapore, offshore and Hong Kong investment fund.

OUB said in a statement the move was made because OUBAM had a regional equities fund management team and the infrastructure necessary to handle investment matters and make recommendations needed by OUI.
